passages.quote:
This document provides practical guidance to support local implementation of the Men’s Health Strategy for England. The guidance is intended for a range of local system partners, including:

health and wellbeing boards (HWBs)

integrated care boards (ICBs)

local authorities, including directors of public health

primary care networks

NHS providers

It is not mandatory and is designed to support partners to embed men’s health within existing local priorities, plans and services.
